title: First Time Developer Finance UK
summary: Silver Oak Capital's page on development finance for first-time developers (UK). Per search summaries, the page frames the first-time developer 'catch-22' (lenders want prior experience, but experience requires finance; high-street banks almost universally reject applicants with no track record of a similar build), defines the product as development finance structured for individuals or companies undertaking their first ground-up scheme or major conversion, and explains that underwriting focuses less on the borrower's personal track record and more on the assembled team (project manager, architect, main contractor) and the economic feasibility of the scheme. Examples of who it suits: experienced flippers moving into ground-up builds, and contractors who have never been the named borrower or developer. FAQ content states Silver Oak can match a first-project borrower with a lender specialising in 'First Time Developer' products provided there is a strong team. No loan sizes, LTV/LTC/LTGDV, rates, fees, durations or timescales specific to this product were revealed by any of the 3 searches.
